body.summary:
HighLevel shipped 5 updates this week. Here are the ones worth your time.

1. Fairer SMS safeguards: standard texting pauses drop to 12 hours, with quality judged on a rolling 7 days (rolling out to selected sub-accounts)
2. Even and weighted splits in workflows: send leads to each rep in turn, or give one team a bigger share
3. Workflow cleanup: Workflow Maps flags unused workflows, default names and empty folders for review
4. AI agents that make short branded films: Managed Agents create multi-shot videos up to 60 seconds, billed per second
5. Affiliate compliance: collect signed terms, W9 or W8 forms and payout details (new Client Portal only)

Want any of these set up in your account? Book a quick call with us. The link is in the first comment.

body.summary:
Your HighLevel account got better this week.

Every Friday I pull the releases that matter for business owners out of the HighLevel changelog. This week's five:

1. Fairer SMS safeguards: standard texting pauses drop to 12 hours, with quality judged on a rolling 7 days (rolling out to selected sub-accounts)
2. Even and weighted splits in workflows: send leads to each rep in turn, or give one team a bigger share
3. Workflow cleanup: Workflow Maps flags unused workflows, default names and empty folders for review
4. AI agents that make short branded films: Managed Agents create multi-shot videos up to 60 seconds, billed per second
5. Affiliate compliance: collect signed terms, W9 or W8 forms and payout details (new Client Portal only)

The two I'd look at first: the new split options, because routing leads evenly (or by the percentages you choose) is how you stop one salesperson getting buried while another waits, and the workflow cleanup tool, because a tidy account is easier to trust and easier to fix when something breaks. If you want help turning any of these on, or want to know which ones fit your business, the link to reach us is in the first comment.
